Exact target sense: {"word":"to","pos":"prep.","meaning":"到"}.
Scene: a small backpacked child has followed a gently curved outdoor footpath from a tiny cottage at the back left TO a single large leafy tree at the front right. The child is taking the last step and has just reached the tree, with one hand touching its trunk. Visible footprints trace the completed journey along the path. A single soft coral hand-painted directional arrow lies along the path and ends exactly at the tree roots, emphasizing the destination endpoint. The large tree is the destination, the cottage only the origin. The endpoint and arriving child are dominant. Depict arrival at an outdoor destination, with no doorway, threshold, crossing into an enclosure, vehicle or gifts. This is the directional preposition meaning 到, not a portrait or a simple walking action.
